properties.description: Unreleased after v0.56.0. Two accepted requirements that had nothing delivering them, both of them questions a user asks in their own words rather than reflow2's. Taken together because they are the same shape: a fact about the design that somebody was answering with a hand-written script, or not at all. The first reading of each on reflow2's own graph: 248 repairs and not one states its disposition; 11 of 208 Requirements carry an incoming VERIFIES.
properties.name: The design answers two questions about itself — what still rests on a patch, and what fraction of a kind carries a relation
